table.title: Audio and subtitles
titles.scope.title: For this title
overrides.title: Show and movie overrides
overrides.help: Choices for single shows and movies, in place of the library choice. To add one, open the ⋮ menu of a show or movie and choose "Audio and subtitles (Babelfin)".
overrides.helpAdmin: Choices this person set for single shows and movies, in place of the library choice. People set them from the ⋮ menu of a show or movie, under "Audio and subtitles (Babelfin)".
overrides.empty: No show or movie overrides yet.
overrides.removeAll: Remove all show and movie overrides
overrides.removeAll.confirmTitle: Remove all show and movie overrides?
overrides.removeAll.confirmText: Every show and movie goes back to its library choice. This can't be undone.
overrides.removeAll.confirmTextFor: Every show and movie goes back to {name}'s library choices. This can't be undone.
overrides.removeAll.done: All show and movie overrides were removed.
advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.enabled: Let Babelfin choose your audio and subtitles
advanced.enabled.info: Turn this off to let Jellyfin choose tracks for you as it would without Babelfin. Your settings are kept for when you turn it back on.
advanced.trackChanges.help: When you switch a track Babelfin chose while watching, Babelfin uses your pick from then on instead of your library choice. Each one is listed under Show and movie overrides, where you can remove it.
advanced.burnedIn.help: Titles whose picture already shows subtitles.
advanced.nextEpisode.help: Turns off Jellyfin's "Set audio track based on previous item" and "Set subtitle track based on previous item" for you, so these settings apply to every episode.
startOver.confirm.title: Remove all your settings?
startOver.confirm.text: Your languages, library choices, show and movie overrides and remembered track changes will be removed. This can't be undone.
restore.confirm.title: Restore defaults?
restore.confirm.text: Every option under Subtitles, Audio and Track changes goes back to its default. Your languages, your audio and subtitle choices, and your show and movie overrides stay as they are.
ui.table.smart: When the audio isn't in my languages
ui.table.defaultPerLibrary: Default (set by the server for each library)
ui.table.videoDefaultHelp: Video default: the track the video file marks as default (or your Jellyfin playback settings, if you set any).
ui.table.smartHelp: When the audio isn't in my languages: full subtitles when the audio isn't in a language listed under My languages, otherwise only signs and songs.
ui.table.admin.smart: When the audio isn't in the viewer's languages
ui.table.admin.videoDefaultHelp: Video default: the track the video file marks as default (or the viewer's Jellyfin playback settings, if they set any).
ui.table.admin.smartHelp: When the audio isn't in the viewer's languages: full subtitles when the audio isn't in one of the viewer's languages, otherwise only signs and songs.
ui.search.label: Search
ui.search.error: The search didn't work. Try again.
field.Reads.label: Languages for subtitles
field.Reads.help: In order of preference. When a Subtitles choice above doesn't name a language, such as "When the audio isn't in my languages" or "Signs and songs only", Babelfin uses the first of these languages that the video has subtitles in.
field.UsesAudioDescription.label: Audio description tracks
field.UsesAudioDescription.info: Some videos have an extra audio track in which a narrator describes what happens on screen, for people who are blind or have low vision. Babelfin skips these tracks unless you prefer them.
field.PrefersSdh.label: Always show subtitles
field.PrefersSdh.info: Shows full subtitles even when the audio is in one of your languages, and picks SDH subtitles when a video has them. Meant for people who are deaf or hard of hearing, and for anyone who always wants subtitles.
field.AvoidCommentary.label: Commentary tracks
field.AvoidCommentary.info: Commentary tracks are the director or cast talking about the film while it plays. Babelfin skips them unless a video has no other audio.
field.UnknownAudioCountsAsUnderstood.lab: When the audio's language is unknown
field.UnknownAudioCountsAsUnderstood.inf: Some videos don't say what language their audio is in, so Babelfin can't tell whether it is one of My languages. This decides what the Subtitles choice "When the audio isn't in my languages" does then.
field.Sdh.label: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (SDH)
field.Sdh.info: SDH subtitles also describe sounds, such as [door slams] or [music playing]. When a video has both kinds in the same language, this decides which one Babelfin picks.
field.Sdh.byAlways: Set by "Always show subtitles", which picks SDH subtitles.
field.Format.label: Text or picture subtitles
field.Format.info: Text subtitles (such as SRT or ASS) work in every app. Picture subtitles (such as PGS or VobSub, from Blu-rays and DVDs) make many apps convert the video while it plays, which takes more work from the server.
field.Embedded.label: Embedded or separate subtitle files
field.Embedded.info: Embedded subtitles are stored inside the video file. Separate subtitle files sit next to it, such as an .srt file or subtitles Jellyfin downloaded. When a video has both in the same language, this decides which one Babelfin picks.
field.IfNothingMatches.label: When there are no full subtitles in your languages
field.IfNothingMatches.info: Used when Babelfin wants full subtitles but the video has none in your Languages for subtitles. Signs and songs subtitles only translate on-screen text and song lyrics.
field.Memory.label: Remember track changes for
field.Memory.info: How long a track you switch to while watching is kept: for the rest of the show, this season, or only this episode or movie. With "Don't remember", the switch only lasts until playback ends.
enum.WhenNothingMatches.FullInAnyBackupL: Show full subtitles in another of your languages
